question: Should OpenClaw accept reset-family prompt carryover as a default-off experimental core agent feature in this stacked PR, or should the base family-history PR land first and this branch rebase afterward?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and tested, but it changes public history selectors, future session-store lineage, and provider-bound prompt context in a way that requires maintainer product and privacy-boundary intent.

options.title: Land base family history first
options.body: Merge or otherwise resolve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 first, then rebase this PR so maintainers review only the carryover layer and its provider-boundary opt-in.

options.title: Accept combined stack
options.body: Treat this PR as the combined includeFamily plus carryover landing path and own the larger session-state/API review in one merge.

options.title: Pause carryover direction
options.body: Keep or close the carryover layer until maintainers decide whether archived summaries should ever be injected automatically into embedded-agent prompts.

recommendation.title: Land base family history first
recommendation.body: Merge or otherwise resolve https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90239 first, then rebase this PR so maintainers review only the carryover layer and its provider-boundary opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest routed owner from the PR discussion and has recent adjacent agent-session routing history.
